items.description: Close the wall opening and repaint the disturbed area
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.2 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the wall opened to reach the leaking pipe. Allow €320 gross for closing, patching and repainting the local area only under 7.1.5.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. Allow €42 gross for one local call-out, consistent with Case 32.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers minor sealing consumables used in the pipe repair, including lump-sum charges. Allow €10 gross for the local repair.

items.description: First stainless steel pipe charge, 1 m
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover the necessary replacement section at the pre-loss specification. Allow €24 gross for one metre of ordinary supply pipe, with no upgrade premium under 7.1.9.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating insulation that formed part of the repaired installation. Allow €12 gross for one metre of equivalent insulation.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary trade labour at customary rates. Allow one hour at €96 gross, in line with the installer rate in Case 32.

Section 7.1.8(b) excludes the contractor's own diagnostic and measuring devices, even though necessary investigation labour is covered. The conditional €18 allowance applies only if the charge proves to be for a separately covered equipment deployment.

items.description: First service technician labour charge, 9 hours billed
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(g) limits labour to the time reasonably needed. Allow about four hours at €90 gross for investigation, access and drying setup or checks, apart from the separately billed installer and painter work.

Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge on this contractor's invoice, even if multiple visits were needed. The conditional €42 reflects the ordinary price of one eligible call-out, not an allowance for the return visit.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) allow one equipment flat rate for necessary drying. Allow €105 gross for short deployment in the local wall area, excluding labour priced separately.
Section 7.1.8(b) specifically excludes contractor blades as business equipment. The conditional €9 is the ordinary gross cost of one blade.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers ordinary fittings needed to connect the replacement pipe. Allow two fittings at €17 gross each, provided they match the documented repair.

items.description: Second stainless steel pipe charge, 1 m
items.rationale: Section 7.1.8(c) disallows duplicate charges, and the description does not establish a second distinct pipe section. If a separate necessary metre is documented, allow €24 gross under 7.1.7(c).

Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) bar duplicate or unattributed materials; this appears to repeat the insulation already charged for the same repair. If a distinct length of equivalent insulation is documented, allow €12 gross.

items.description: Second service technician labour charge, 9 hours billed
items.rationale: Section 7.1.8(c) disallows the repeated labour charge unless distinct work is documented. If separate necessary work is shown, an estimated two additional hours at €90 gross would be reasonable under 7.1.7(g), rather than another nine hours.
